content.value_statement: Real-time voice apps need correct Azure Voice Live setup. This skill guides .NET sessions, authentication, event handling, voices, models, and audio options.
actual_capabilities: Lists required NuGet packages for Azure.AI.VoiceLive, Azure.Identity, and audio playback.
Explains environment variables for endpoint, model, voice, and optional API key setup.
Shows authentication choices using Microsoft Entra ID or an Azure API key.
Describes session configuration for modalities, voice selection, turn detection, and audio formats.
Outlines event handling for audio deltas, text deltas, function calls, errors, and response completion.
Summarizes supported voices, models, key SDK types, audio settings, and reference links.
limitations: It is documentation guidance, not a runnable sample application.
It does not capture or play microphone audio by itself.
It requires an Azure AI resource and valid credentials from the user.
SDK versions and model availability may change after the skill was written.

use_cases.title: Prototype a Voice Assistant
use_cases.description: Plan the packages, credentials, session settings, and event loop for a .NET voice assistant.

use_cases.title: Design a Support Voice Bot
use_cases.description: Use session options, function calling, and voice choices to shape a real-time support workflow.

use_cases.title: Review Voice Live Integration
use_cases.description: Check authentication, event handling, audio format choices, and cleanup patterns before implementation.

prompt_templates.title: Start a Voice Live Project
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me start a .NET project with Azure AI Voice Live. List the packages, environment variables, and authentication choices I need.

prompt_templates.title: Configure a Session
prompt_templates.prompt: Guide me through Azure AI Voice Live session options for a .NET voice assistant with text and audio responses.

prompt_templates.title: Handle Session Events
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me design an event handling flow for VoiceLiveSession updates, including audio, text, function calls, errors, and completion.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Function Calling
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a safe function calling workflow for Azure AI Voice Live in .NET, including tool definition, argument handling, and response output.

output_examples.input: I need to choose between Entra ID and API key authentication.
output: Use Microsoft Entra ID when the app runs in an Azure-aware identity environment.
Use an API key only when identity setup is not available or during limited local testing.
Keep credentials outside source control and prefer environment-based configuration.

output_examples.input: Review my Voice Live event loop plan.
output: Handle audio deltas separately from text deltas so playback and transcripts stay responsive.
Treat function call completion as a separate branch that validates arguments before returning output.
Log service errors and dispose the session when conversation work is complete.

output_examples.input: Plan audio settings for a speech-to-speech assistant.
output_examples.output: Use PCM16 audio, mono input, and a 24 kHz target sample rate. Tune silence duration for the expected speaking style.

best_practices: Prefer DefaultAzureCredential for production authentication and keep API keys out of source control.
Configure both text and audio modalities when building a voice assistant workflow.
Handle every major session update type, including errors and response completion.
anti_patterns: Do not hardcode Azure API keys in application code or prompts.
Do not ignore session error events during real-time audio conversations.
Do not assume every Azure voice, model, or preview feature is available in every region.

faq.question: Does this skill include runnable project files?
faq.answer: No. It provides implementation guidance and examples for Azure AI Voice Live in .NET.

faq.question: Which authentication method does it recommend?
faq.answer: It recommends Microsoft Entra ID with DefaultAzureCredential. API key use is described as optional.

faq.question: Can it help with real-time speech-to-speech apps?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers bidirectional sessions, audio deltas, voices, models, and PCM16 audio settings.

faq.question: Does it explain function calling?
faq.answer: Yes. It describes defining a voice function, handling completed arguments, and returning function output.

faq.question: Does it replace Azure documentation?
faq.answer: No. It summarizes common setup patterns and links to official package, API, source, and quickstart resources.

faq.question: Can Claude, Codex, or Claude Code use this skill?
faq.answer: Yes. The report declares support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code workflows.
